Container.Name: access-window-api
Container.Overview:
Access Window - the FastAPI backend for scheduled, per-parent camera viewing (login, invites, stream tokens, camera health/Pushover alerts). Needs the access-window-mediamtx container reachable by name - put both containers on the same custom Docker network, whatever you already use for your NPMPlus-fronted apps.
First run only: docker exec access-window-api python -m app.seed
Container.Requires: access-window-mediamtx, on the same custom Docker network as this container

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the app listens on - point your NPMPlus proxy host here

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Random 32+ character secret for session cookies

Config.Name: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Keep true once NPMPlus is terminating TLS in front of this. Set false ONLY while testing directly against http://ip:8000 with no TLS yet - otherwise login silently fails to persist (bounces back to the login page).

Config.Name: STREAM_TOKEN_SECRET
Config.Description: Random secret, must differ from SESSION_SECRET

Config.Name: STREAM_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
Config.Description: Not the cutoff enforcement - MediaMTX re-checks the real schedule every segment regardless. Keep this long so the viewer doesn't have to reload playback to refresh it.

Config.Name: APP_TIMEZONE
Config.Description: Everyone is assumed local to this timezone

Config.Name: MEDIAMTX_API_URL
Config.Description: Container name of the mediamtx container - only reachable if both share a Docker network

Config.Name: MEDIAMTX_HLS_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS URL NPMPlus fronts MediaMTX's HLS output as, e.g. https://cameras.yourdomain.com/hls

Config.Name: PUSHOVER_APP_TOKEN
Config.Description: Pushover Application token (pushover.net/apps/build) - shared by the whole app

Config.Name: SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Used once by `docker exec access-window-api python -m app.seed`

Config.Name: SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Used once by `docker exec access-window-api python -m app.seed`
